{{Quote|You want me to make sure you don't get matched again? Protect that youngling of yours? Word is you've been training him hard on your own, trying to teach him the Fifty-two Fists, get him ready for his first match. You think he actually stands a chance in there?|[[Voystock]], to Artagan Truax|<ref name="Lockdown">''[[Maul: Lockdown]]''</ref>}}
The '''Fifty-two Fists''' was the name of an [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]] fighting move. Comprising a blizzard of lightning-fast attacks over a period of less than five [[Standard second|seconds]], the attack required total commitment to absolute destruction of the opponent. Done properly, it could [[Death/Legends|kill]] a fighter three times the practitioner's size and weight. However, even the slightest tremor of intent left the fighter wide open to all manner of retribution. [[Artagan Truax]] taught his son [[Eogan Truax|Eogan]] this combat technique while preparing him for [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] fights onboard the [[Cog Hive Seven]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. Later, Eogan successfully used the Fifty-two Fists to kill six blind armed workers sent by [[Iram Radique]] to murder Artagan.<ref name="Lockdown" />
